mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises by at least 1.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an active monetary policy response to inflation, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities due to higher real interest rates and reduced profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of rising CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above 6.0% and declines by at least 0.2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) fall below 800.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market and weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a further acceleration in inflation signals persistent price pressures that may lead the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which typically boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
